title: Microsoft 365 admin center gets Cross-Tenant Orchestrated Migration for users and shared data, GA targeted December 2026
summary: Roadmap item RM576273 (In development, GA targeted December 2026, worldwide) adds Cross-Tenant Orchestrated Migration to the Microsoft 365 admin center. User Data Migration (UDM) covers mailboxes, OneDrive accounts, Teams chats and Teams meetings; Shared Data Migration (SDM) covers Microsoft 365 Groups, SharePoint sites, group mailboxes, and teams and channels. The entry lists 'More info: TBD'.
why: Tenant-to-tenant moves (M&A, divestitures) have meant stitching together separate cross-tenant mailbox and OneDrive migrations, or third-party tools. A first-party orchestrator for Teams chats and shared data changes the build-vs-buy decision — and creates a new high-privilege, two-tenant trust that belongs in your Tier 0 change process.
todo: If a tenant consolidation is planned for 2027, hold the tooling decision until Microsoft publishes prerequisites, licensing and required permissions.
Treat any cross-tenant migration trust as privileged: named owners, time-limited, removed after cutover.
